title: Second and third conditionals: more practice
instructionEs: Empareja, clasifica, traduce, escucha y completa.

items.explanationEs: Si + -ra / -se es if + pasado (o had + participio). -ría es would; habría es would have.

categories.label: Second conditional
items: If she knew, she'd tell us.
I'd be happier if I lived by the sea.

categories.label: Third conditional
items: If I had won, I'd have travelled.
If she had known, she'd have told us.
I'd have been happier if I'd stayed.

items.explanationEs: Condicional 2: if + pasado y would. Condicional 3: if + had + participio y would have + participio.

items.es: Si fuera rico, compraría una casa grande.
answers: If I were rich, I would buy a big house.

items.explanationEs: Si fuera es if I were (o if I was); compraría es would buy.

items.text: I would have called you if I had known.
items.explanationEs: Condicional 3: would have + participio (called) y if + had + participio (known).
